notes: Source: 2026 San Francisco 49ers Media Guide (IA item san-francisco-49ers-2026-media-guide-2026-08-10). Individual records are on printed pages 468-507; the regular-season lists used here are the 'ALL-TIME REGULAR SEASON PASSING / RUSHING / RECEIVING / INTERCEPTIONS / SACKS' pages = pdf p472-473 (passing), p475-476 (rushing), p477-478 (receiving), p480 (interceptions), p481 (sacks). PDF page = printed page + 1 (pdf p472 is printed 471). Postseason, opponent and team-record pages (p508-512, 515+) were not used.

through_season 2025: the lists contain 2025 entries (Brock Purdy 5 TD passes at Ind. 12/22/25, Christian McCaffrey's 2025 season: 102 receptions and 10 rushing TDs, Brandon Aiyuk career 2020-2025) and the guide has 2025 regular-season statistics (printed pp. 414-415) and 2025 game summaries (printed pp. 449-467). Deebo Samuel Sr. is printed '2019-2024, 2026-present' and several players '...-present', so the guide was prepared for the 2026 season but the statistics stop after 2025.

Ranks are the printed rank labels. Rows tied with the row above are printed without a rank label; they keep the rank of the first row of the tie and every tied row has tie=true. One row has no rank label although it is not tied: Roger Craig 1985 (92 receptions) in the season receptions table sits between 9 and 11, so I gave it rank 10 (raw shows it as printed, without the label).

The guide's lists are NFL-era (from 1950) only: Joe Perry's career rushing yards are printed '7,344 +' with the footnote '+ does not include AAFC Statistics'. Career lists printed as boxes (pass TDs, rushing TDs, receiving yards, receiving TDs) print no years; their years spans were copied from the ALL-TIME LEADING PASSERS / RUSHERS / RECEIVERS table on the same page (not from memory).

The boxes headed only 'MOST TOUCHDOWNS, Career' on the rushing and receiving pages are rushing TDs and receiving TDs respectively (they sit under 'ALL-TIME REGULAR SEASON RUSHING/RECEIVING' and equal the TD column of the yards/receptions table above them). Season/game boxes on those pages are headed 'MOST RUSHING TOUCHDOWNS' / 'MOST RECEIVING TOUCHDOWNS'.

Aggregate lines not transcribed as player rows (same treatment as CIN): game rushing TDs '3. (14 times) Last: Christian McCaffrey vs. Arz. (10/1/23) 3'; game receiving TDs '3. (19 times) Last: Jauan Jennings at LAR (9/22/24) 3'; season receiving TDs '9. (6 times) Last: Vernon Davis (2013) 13'. The game rushing-TD list therefore has one row and the game receiving-TD list two.

Game lists: the guide prints dates as M/D/YY ('at Atl. (10/14/90)'); `years` shows M/D/YYYY plus the printed opponent text (two-digit year expanded, 00-30 -> 20xx, others 19xx; the franchise has NFL data only from 1950), `raw` keeps the printed form. Position tags such as (QB) (TE) (RB) (WR) (DT) and ', QB' are dropped from `name` but kept in raw. Typographic dashes and apostrophes were written as '-' and "'". Rookie-year marker '2011*' (Aldon Smith, season sacks) kept in raw.

Sacks: career list carries the printed note 'Includes figures since 1982, when sacks first became an official statistic' (so Dwaine Board 1979-88 and Fred Dean 1981-85 are partial careers). All single-season and single-game sack entries are 1983 or later.

Tackles: the only franchise tackles list is the career top-5 'MOST TACKLES, FRANCHISE HISTORY' box on Fred Warner's player page (pdf p377). Warner's 947 includes 2025 (the same page's bio text says 896 after 2024). No season or game tackles list exists (see missing). Other tackle lists in the guide (playoff leaders, rookie leaders, 2025 team bests) are not all-player regular-season records.

Verification: every digit was read from 200-300 dpi crops of the page pictures. Table columns were cross-checked by script (work/agent_SF/verify3.py: completion %, passer rating, INT %, average = yards/attempts, receptions or INTs) and every box list was cross-checked against the main table on the same page (verify4.py); all agree except two inconsistencies PRINTED in the guide, transcribed as printed: Vernon Davis's career line (441 receptions, 5,640 yards but printed average 12.9; 5,640/441 = 12.8) and Jimmy Garoppolo's 2019 season line (13 INT on 476 attempts but printed INT Pct 2.9; computed 2.7). The 'Led NFL' ovals and 'Led Conference' boxes printed around some numbers were ignored.
